# West Africa Gaming Convention (WAGCON 2027)

> WAGCON 2027 is Africa's premier B2B gaming, esports, game publishing, and interactive entertainment convention. Held over 4 days across 3 venues in Victoria Island, Lagos, Nigeria from 28 April to 1 May 2027. Co-located with ABDS 2027 (Africa Blockchain Week). Produced by T.U.A Events.

## Event Details
- **Event Name:** West Africa Gaming Convention (WAGCON 2027)
- **Dates:** 28 April – 1 May 2027
- **Location:** Victoria Island, Lagos, Nigeria
- **Co-located Event:** ABDS 2027 (Africa Blockchain Week) — https://www.abds.com.ng
- **Organizer:** T.U.A Events (info@tuaevents.org / +234 915 461 1827)
- **Official Website:** https://wagconvention.com
- **Official Ticketing & Sponsor Form:** https://app.eventpadi.com/wagcon

## Venues
1. **VIP Leaders Dinner (Day 1 · 28 April 2027):** Four Points by Sheraton, Victoria Island, Lagos.
2. **Main Conference & B2B Exhibition (Days 2 & 3 · 29–30 April 2027):** Lagos Oriental Hotel, Victoria Island, Lagos.
3. **Official After Party (Day 4 · 1 May 2027):** La Maison de Fahrenheit, Victoria Island, Lagos.

## Early Bird Sponsorship & Exhibition Pricing
- **Super Early Bird:** 30% OFF (Deadline: 30 September 2026) — First access to preferred booth positions.
- **Early Bird 2:** 15% OFF (Deadline: 30 November 2026) — Priority exhibition & branding.
- **Early Bird 3:** 10% OFF (Deadline: 31 January 2027) — Programme and visibility consideration.
- **Final Early Bird:** 5% OFF (Deadline: 15 March 2027) — Final discounted rate before standard pricing.

## Delegate Pass Tiers
- **Green Pass:** Free (Exhibition Floor Access, Days 2 & 3)
- **Standard Pass:** ₦30,000 (Conference & Exhibition Access, Days 2 & 3)
- **Blue Pass:** ₦75,000 (Full Summit Access, Workshop Masterclasses, After Party, Catering)
- **Gold Pass:** ₦350,000 (VIP Summit Access, VIP Leaders Dinner Day 1, VIP After Party Lounge, Front-row Seating, 1-on-1 Introductions)

## Key Statistics & Market Context
- 2,400+ expected delegates across 25+ countries.
- 120+ exhibiting brands, game studios, and technology providers.
- 80+ industry speakers and 14 content tracks.
- 62% of delegates are C-level executives, studio heads, founders, or investors.
- West Africa / Nigeria mobile gaming population exceeds 40 million active gamers.
- Africa mobile gaming market projected to surpass $1B by 2027.

## Key Content Tracks
Mobile Gaming, Esports & Competitive Gaming, Web3 & Blockchain Gaming, Game Publishing & Distribution, AI in Game Development, AR/VR Immersive Gaming, Indie Game Development, Gaming VC & Investment, Gaming Policy & Regulation, Monetization & Game Economy, Game Design & UX, Creator Economy, Console & PC Gaming, African Game Studios.
